items.src: APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer and Analyst Grade-II
items.s: Which of the following is the scientific name of the floating hydrozoan 'Portuguese Man o' War'?
items.x: The Portuguese man o' war is Physalia physalis, a floating colonial hydrozoan. Echinus is a sea urchin, Chaetopleura a chiton and Meandrina a brain coral.

items.src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
items.s: Which practice helps in flood control?
items.x: Afforestation helps flood control by binding soil and slowing run-off; deforestation, overgrazing and urbanisation increase floods.

items.s: Sending data to the network service provider is known as
items.x: Sending signals from a ground station up to a satellite or network is the uplink; receiving from it is the downlink. Modulation and demodulation are signal processing.

items.src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officers (Grade-II) General Studies & M
items.s: Dassault Aviation is a firm located in:
items.x: Dassault Aviation, maker of the Rafale and Mirage fighters, is a French firm based in Paris.

items.s: Sriharikota range, which is India's satellite launch centre, is located in which state?
items.x: The Satish Dhawan Space Centre at Sriharikota is in Tirupati (formerly Nellore) district, Andhra Pradesh. Thumba is in Kerala, and Kulasekarapattinam (new SSLV port) is in Tamil Nadu.

items.s:
Match the following
List-I -
List-II

a. Radio Broadcasting - i. LF Band

b. Marine and Navigational aids - ii. HF Band

c. T.V. Broadcasting - iii. SHF Band

d. Satellite Communication - iv. VHF Band
The correct match is
items.x: Radio broadcasting (short wave) uses the HF band, marine navigational aids the LF band, TV broadcasting VHF and satellite communication SHF.

items.s:
For the measurement/estimation of which of the following are satellite images/ remote sensing data used?

I. Chlorophyll content in the vegetation of a specific location.

II. Greenhouse gas emission from rice paddies of a specific location.

III. Land surface temperature of a specific location.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
items.x: Satellite data estimate chlorophyll (NDVI), land surface temperature (thermal infrared) and methane/GHG emissions from rice paddies, so all three are correct.

items.s: What is the venue of the 2020 UN Ocean Conference?
items.x: The 2020 UN Ocean Conference, co-hosted by Kenya and Portugal, was set for Lisbon, Portugal (postponed by COVID-19 and held there in June-July 2022).

items.s: Which one of the following was the first country to declare ‘Climate Emergency’?
items.x: The UK Parliament declared a climate emergency on 1 May 2019, the first national parliament to do so; Ireland followed days later.

items.s: Chandrayan II is designed jointly by India and:
items.x: Chandrayaan-2 began (2007-08) as an ISRO-Roscosmos project in which Russia was to supply the lander; Russia withdrew, so ISRO built Vikram itself.

items.s:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding GSLV-II

a. It was launched from Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota

b. It was launched from Kourou launch base French Guiana

c. Launch vehicle was Delta-IV

d. Launch vehicle was Ariane-5
items.x: The stem is garbled: it evidently means GSAT-11, launched on 5 Dec 2018 from Kourou, French Guiana, on Ariane-5 (b and d). A GSLV itself flies from Sriharikota, and Delta-IV is an American rocket.

items.s: The computer’s processor consists which of the following parts?
items.x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (Control Unit and ALU); it is added as option 5.
The processor (CPU) consists of the control unit and the arithmetic logic unit (with registers). CPU and main memory (the processor cannot contain itself), discs, main memory and storage, and OS/applications are not its parts; the original IBPS PO 2011 paper had a fifth option 'Control Unit and ALU'.

items.src: APPSC Assistant Chemist (AP Ground Water Service, AP Insuran
items.s: Which of the following is incorrect about acids?
o: Aqueous solutions of acids are electrolytes
Acids can change the colour of certain acid-base indicators
Acids do not react with active metals
items.x: Acids do react with active metals (e.g. zinc, iron) to give hydrogen gas, so that statement is incorrect. Aqueous acids conduct electricity, taste sour and change indicator colours.

items.src: APPSC Forest Subordinate Service (Thanedar) Paper-II General
items.s: While cooking if bottom of the vessel is getting blackened on the outside, it means that
o: The food is not burning completely
The fuel is not burning completely
items.x: A blackened vessel bottom means soot (unburnt carbon) from incomplete burning of the fuel.

items.s: What is the definition of USB in computer terms?
items.x: USB = Universal Serial Bus, the standard port and cable for connecting peripherals. Off-topic, moved to hardware.

items.s: India's first Gramin Cyber Centre was launched in
items.x: India's first rural cyber centre ('Cyber Grameen Centre', Swarna Bharat Trust) opened in 2003 at Venkatachalam, Nellore district, Andhra Pradesh.

items.src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
items.s: In which year was the National e-Governance Division created by Central Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology?
items.x: The National e-Governance Division (NeGD) was created in 2009 by MeitY (then DeitY) as an independent business division under Media Lab Asia; it now runs UMANG, DigiLocker and Meri Pehchaan.

items.s:
Read the following statements

(a) Carbohydrates synthesized in the leaves are translocated to other parts of the plant through Xylem.

(b) Recombinant DNA is also known as chimaeric DNA.

(c) Programmed cell death is known as 'apoptosis'.
items.x: Recombinant DNA is also called chimaeric DNA, and programmed cell death is apoptosis, so (b) and (c) are correct. (a) is wrong because carbohydrates move through phloem, not xylem.

items.src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
items.s:
Match the following organic amendments with their descriptions.

1. Animal manure

2. Compost

3. Crop residue

4. Green manure crops

a. Consists of decomposed plant and animal waste, which improves soil organic matter and microbial activity

b. Freshly grown crops that are incorporated into the soil to improve fertility and nutrient availability

c. Animal-derived waste such as dung and urine, which provides essential nutrients for soil and crops

d. Remains of harvested crops that can be incorporated into the soil to enhance organic matter content
items.x: Animal manure = dung and urine (c), compost = decomposed plant and animal waste (a), crop residue = harvest remains (d), green manure = fresh crops ploughed in (b), so 1-c, 2-a, 3-d, 4-b.

items.src: APPSC AEE Electrical Engineering Screening Test General Stud
items.s: Which of the following lamps is the cheapest for the same wattage?
items.x: The General Lighting Service (incandescent) lamp has the lowest first cost for a given wattage, though it is the least efficient.

items.s:
The world's first hydrogen fuel cell car reached Sydney on December 27, 2003.
Which of the following statements are true about the car?

a) It was designed, built and run by the students of Tamagawa University of Tokyo.

b) It is named after the Biblical gods of Sun and Water.

c) Its name is Isaac Moses.

d) It completed the world's first continental crossing by completing a 4084 km run in less than nine days.

e) Its name is Apollondine.
f) It was designed and built by the students of Tokugawa University, but run by the students of the University of Perth.
items.x: 'Apollondine' was designed, built and driven by Tamagawa University students and crossed Australia (4,084 km) to reach Sydney on 27 Dec 2003 – a, d, e.

items.src: APPSC AE (Subordinate Services) Mains General Studies & Ment
items.s: Cissus Quadrangularis (Nalleru) is used as medicine for
items.x: Nalleru (Cissus quadrangularis, 'bone setter') is used in traditional medicine for bone health and fracture healing.

items.s: The first unmanned tank developed by Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) is
items.x: Muntra (Mission Unmanned Tracked), developed by CVRDE Chennai and unveiled in 2017, is DRDO's first unmanned tank. Nag is an anti-tank missile, Pinaka a rocket launcher and Bhishma the T-90 tank.

items.src: Technical Asst. (Hydrology), Laboratory Assistants in AP Gro
items.s: Which of the following chemical compound added to bread was banned in India
items.x: FSSAI removed potassium bromate from the list of permitted additives in 2016 after CSE found it in bread (possible carcinogen). Gluconate, sulphate and oxalate were not the banned bread additive.

items.s:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about Airborne Laser Terrain Mapping (ALTM)?

I. It is a cheap, fast accurate way of creating 3D digital picture of the earth surface and objects on it.

II. Currently it is mainly used for mapping or survey application
items.x: Airborne Laser Terrain Mapping is airborne LiDAR: a fast, accurate and cost-effective way to build a 3D digital picture of the ground (I), used today mainly for mapping and survey (II). So both are correct.

items.src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
items.s: When any one experiences acidity problem, he may get immediate relief by taking a glass of water in which, a tea spoon of the following substance is dissolved?
items.x: Acidity is neutralised by a weak base such as baking soda (sodium bicarbonate) or an antacid dissolved in water; a strong base would harm the body.

items.s: What is the important change for the present generation of politics of the entire World?
items.x: Climate change is widely called the defining political issue of the present generation for the entire world. 'Environmental crisis' is broader and vaguer; separation of states and social justice are not global changes.

items.src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer (Sainik Welfare Service)
items.s: Normally how many number of Autosomes will be present in human beings?
items.x: Human cells have 46 chromosomes: 22 pairs (44) of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes.

items.s: Tomato belongs to family of:
items.x: Tomato belongs to Solanaceae, the same family as potato, brinjal and chilli. Gramineae is grasses, Leguminosae is pulses and Malvaceae is cotton and okra.

items.src: APPSC Forest Section Officer General Studies & Mental Abilit
items.s: Who among the following has been conferred the Padma Shri, 2019 award by the President of India for his contributions towards organic farming?
items.x: Yadlapalli Venkateswara Rao of Andhra Pradesh received the Padma Shri in 2019 for agriculture, promoting organic and natural farming.

items.s: National Civil Defence College was founded in
items.x: The National Civil Defence College began on 29 April 1957 at Nagpur as the Central Emergency Relief Training Institute.

items.s: Among the following, ‘Hansa-2’ is a
items.x: Hansa is a light two-seat trainer aircraft developed by NAL, Bengaluru (Hansa-2 was a prototype). It is not a satellite, submarine or missile.

items.s: Choose the Correct Pair of applications of Remote Sensing and GIS in the assessment of disasters:
o: A. Remote Sensing - Identification of vulnerable areas; B. GIS - Real-time monitoring of disaster events
A. Remote sensing - calculation of population density in disaster-prone regions; B. GIS - Prediction of landslide hazards based on topographic analysis
A. Remote Sensing - Estimation of rainfall patterns during a cyclone; B. GIS - Mapping the spread of infectious diseases during a disaster
A. Remote Sensing - Assessment of post-disaster damage using satellite imagery; B. GIS - Determination of earth quake magnitudes and epicenter locations
items.x: Option C is the only pair with both uses right: satellites estimate cyclone rainfall and GIS maps disease spread. The printed option D is wrong because quake magnitude and epicentre come from seismographs, not GIS; A and B wrongly give real-time monitoring to GIS and population density to remote sensing.

items.src: APPSC 2021 Mains Junior Assistant Cum Computer Assistant In
items.s: What is the approximate count of MeeSeva authorised agents (working and non-working) in Andhra Pradesh as of January 2023?
items.x: About 11,079 MeeSeva centres and authorised agents (working and non-working) existed in Andhra Pradesh in January 2023.

items.s: Andaman and Nicobar Command is
o: a command of the Indian Army.
a regional command of the Indian Coast Guard.
an integrated theater command operating directly under the Chiefs of Staff Committee.
a joint command of the Indian Navy and the Indian Air Force.
items.x: The Andaman and Nicobar Command (2001) is India's only integrated tri-service theatre command, under the Chiefs of Staff Committee (now the CDS), not a single-service or Navy-IAF command.

items.src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Ward Education and Data
items.s: The nature of software applications can be characterized by their information
items.x: Pressman: the nature of a software application is characterised by its information content and determinacy – both 2 and 3.

items.s: Which of the following cities has India's first 'Techno Park'?
items.x: Technopark, Thiruvananthapuram (1990) was India's first technology park. Gurgaon, Pune and Bangalore came later.

items.s: Aerospace industry in Hyderabad located at
items.x: Adibatla (Ranga Reddy district) hosts Hyderabad's aerospace SEZ, with Tata's aero-structure units (Tata-Sikorsky, Tata-Lockheed).

items.src: APPSC Civil Assistant Surgeon (Specialist) in AP Vaidya Vidh
items.s: Decomposition of vegetable matter into compost is a/an?
items.x: Composting is microbial oxidation of organic matter and releases heat (compost heaps warm up), so it is exothermic.

items.s: Which of the following is not a valid IP address?
items.x: '192.23.350' is not a valid IPv4 address: it has only three octets, and 350 exceeds the maximum octet value of 255. The other three are valid dotted-decimal addresses.

items.s: Satellite communication works through:
items.x: A communication satellite works through transponders, which receive the uplink signal, amplify it, change its frequency and retransmit it as the downlink.

items.s: What is the full form of MOXIE, 2020?
o: Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resource Utilization Experiment
Mars Orbital In-Situ Resource Utilization Experiment
Mars Orbital In-Situ Resource Utilization Exploration
Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resource Utilization Exploration
items.x: MOXIE on NASA's Perseverance rover (2020) is the Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resource Utilization Experiment. It made oxygen from Martian CO2. (Space item, moved.)

items.s: The father of GIS ( Geographic Information System ) is
items.x: Roger Tomlinson is regarded as the father of GIS; the other names are distortions.

items.src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
items.s: The limit of growth is fixed by which of the following factor?
items.x: The limit of growth is fixed by internal (genetic, hormonal) factors of the organism; nutrition and exercise only help reach it.

items.s: DRDO Associated Laser Science and Technology Centre is located at
items.x: LASTEC (Laser Science and Technology Centre) of DRDO is at Metcalfe House, Delhi; it is not in Mumbai, Kolkata or Chennai.

items.src: APPSC Teaching Staff of the Department of Technical Educatio
items.s: In a healthy adult, what is the approximate percentage of white blood cells in total blood volume?
items.x: White blood cells (with platelets) form well under 1% of blood volume (the thin buffy coat), so 'one percent' is the nearest figure.

items.s: Which of the following is named 'Gajraj'?
items.x: 'Gajraj' is the IAF name of the Ilyushin IL-76 heavy transport aircraft; MiG-27 = Bahadur, Jaguar = Shamsher, Mirage 2000 = Vajra.

items.src: APPSC Dental Assistant Surgeons, Zilla Sainik Welfare Office
items.s: What is known as the 'energy molecule' in the living World?
items.x: ATP (adenosine triphosphate) is the energy currency of the cell. TNT is an explosive, ADP is its spent form and DNA is the genetic material.

items.s:
Choose the correct option based on the statements below:
Statement I: Deforestation leads to loss of biodiversity and ecosystem services
Statement II: The government of India has established community-based forest management systems to involve local communities in the conservation and management of forest resources.
items.x: Both are true: deforestation causes loss of biodiversity and ecosystem services, and India has community-based forest management (Joint Forest Management, forest rights) to involve local communities. The printed item had no key.

items.s: Which of the following is contagious?
items.x: Yawning is the well-known contagious behaviour – seeing or hearing others yawn triggers it. Snoring, gnashing (teeth-grinding) and vomiting are not contagious (printed key: gnashing).

items.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Conference of Parties to the Convention on the Conservation on Migratory Species of Wild Animals (CMS COP14):
I. The 14th session of CMS COP14 was held from 12th to 17th February, 2024 at Samarkand, Uzbekistan.
II. The CMS COP14 was convened under the slogan " Migratory species connect the planet and we welcome them home ".
III. CMS COP14 was the first global biodiversity gathering since the adoption of the Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF) 2022. Which among the above statements are correct?
items.x: CMS COP14 was held at Samarkand, Uzbekistan, 12–17 February 2024 and was the first global biodiversity COP after the Kunming-Montreal GBF, so I and III are right; its theme was 'Nature knows no borders', so II is wrong.

items.s: Which of the following is not a component of MS office?
items.x: MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint are MS Office components; Media Player is a separate Windows program.

items.s: Few decades ago, DDT was used to kill mosquitoes. Later, in the recent years, it became very difficult to kill mosquitoes using DDT. Which principle explains the immunity of mosquitoes from DDT?
items.x: DDT-resistant mosquitoes survived and reproduced, so resistance spread over generations – natural selection.

items.s: Where are Tapovan and Vishnugruha hydroelectric projects located?
items.x: Tapovan-Vishnugad and Vishnugad-Pipalkoti projects are in Chamoli district, Uttarakhand.

items.src: APPSC Welfare Organiser in AP Sainik Welfare (General Studie
items.s: The strike plate of a match box is made up of
items.x: The striking surface of a safety-match box carries red phosphorus (with powdered glass); the match head has potassium chlorate. (Off-topic: moved to science.)

items.s: What was the theme of World Environment Day, 2016 celebrated on 5th June
o: "Seven Billion Dreams; One Planet; Consume with Care"
items.x: WED 2016 (host Angola) was on zero tolerance for the illegal trade in wildlife ('Go Wild for Life'); 'Seven Billion Dreams' was 2015, 'Small Islands' 2014, 'Think, Eat, Save' 2013.

items.src: APPSC Group-IV Paper-I Mains General Studies & Mental Abilit
items.s:
A: The term sustainability is broadly used to indicate programs, initiatives and actions aimed at the preservation of a particular resource.
R: Sustainability is achieved by the social and economic improvement that protects the environment and supports equality.
o: Both A and R are individually true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are individually true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
items.x: A is true (sustainability = actions to preserve a resource); R is a true statement about SD but does not explain A's definition.
